name: crawlerpeek
description: Check which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and more) can access a website: robots.txt plus live HTTP. Read-only.
long_description: Crawlerpeek tells you whether AI crawlers can reach a page. For each bot it reports the robots.txt decision and what the page returns when fetched with that bot's user-agent string, and it can generate a robots.txt that names AI crawlers explicitly. The tools only fetch the URL you give them; private and internal addresses are refused.

tools.name: check_ai_access
tools.description: Check whether AI crawlers may access a URL: robots.txt decision and live HTTP status per bot.

tools.name: see_as_bot
tools.description: Fetch one URL with a single bot's user-agent string and report status, redirects, size, title and block-page signals.

tools.name: verify_bot_ip
tools.description: Check whether an IP address really belongs to a crawler, using the operator's published IP lists or forward-confirmed reverse DNS.

tools.name: generate_robots_txt
tools.description: Generate a robots.txt that welcomes AI crawlers, with optional disallowed paths and bots to close.

tools.name: lint_robots_txt
tools.description: Lint a robots.txt, fetched from a site or pasted as text, for typos, misplaced rules, relative paths and other mistakes.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Check robots.txt for many pages of one site at once, using the URLs in its sitemap. Reads only robots.txt and the sitemap files.
